sermon.title: An Effective Successful Combination 02/04/2018
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer shows that Jesus, the apostles and deacons like Stephen used one combination: go, preach the gospel and heal the sick, moved by compassion. Women who were healed followed Jesus and provided for him. The Lord confirmed the word with signs. Churches that want God working with them need prayer, fasting, the word and praise.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Points to check: “120 different Baptist churches”; “David was 15 years old when he was used of God” (43:40); met two real apostles in the 1960s. Sensitive content kept as spoken: those who say miracles stopped are “lying to you”; “God is a male”; churches that remove women from ministry “are very wrong”; Copeland and Dollar named as prosperity preachers (18:47); “not one minister had a nervous breakdown”; no compromise on abortion, homosexuality or transgender issues; the “faith camp” teaching called “a lie” (37:00).
